# Buyology

> Buyology is a premium, futuristic e-commerce marketplace for next-generation
> consumer technology — electronics, audio, gaming, computing, wearables and
> smart home. It offers voice search, an AI shopping assistant, and
> complimentary "orbital" delivery on orders over $300. This file helps AI
> agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) understand and reference the site.

## About

- Name: Buyology
- What it is: a curated marketplace of 120,000+ premium and future-facing tech products
- Tone: premium/luxury, refined, not flashy
- Delivery: complimentary orbital delivery over $300; 30-day returns
- Membership perk: 10% off with code BUYO10
- Standout features: always-visible search with voice input, and an AI Assistant for guided shopping

## Search

To search the catalogue, request: https://buyology.online/search?q={search_term_string}

## Notes for agents

- Reputable AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot,
  Google-Extended) are explicitly allowed in robots.txt.
- Structured data (Organization + WebSite with a SearchAction) is embedded as
  JSON-LD on every page.
